tagline: Enhancing corporate value by deepening society's trust in the firm and increasing the satisfaction of stakeholders.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Revenue is the primary indicator of Nomura's overall financial performance, reflecting growth across its three key divisions (Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale).

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company after deducting direct costs.
kpis.description: Net revenue increased by 21.2% for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, demonstrating significant expansion of the company's business activities.
kpis.signal: Significant net revenue growth, indicating strong operational performance.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit after deducting direct costs of production or service delivery.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, indicating the profitability of core operations.

kpis.name: Wealth Management Division Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from wealth management services.
kpis.description: The Wealth Management division saw revenue increase by 12.2% for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, driven by higher inflows and assets under management.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in wealth management revenue, driven by comprehensive services.

kpis.name: Investment Management Division Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from investment management activities.
kpis.description: The Investment Management division recorded a 24.9% increase in revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, benefiting from higher assets under management.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in investment management revenue, reaching record levels.

kpis.name: Wholesale Division Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from wholesale activities, including global markets and investment banking.
kpis.description: The Wholesale division saw revenue increase by 22.1% for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, supported by strong performance in global markets and investment banking.
kpis.signal: Robust growth in Wholesale division revenue, supported across all business lines.

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from ongoing services or subscriptions.
kpis.description: Growing recurring revenue is a strategic objective to diversify revenue sources and ensure stability.

kpis.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income attributable to each outstanding common share.
kpis.description: Diluted earnings per share more than doubled, rising from 52.69 JPY to 111.03 JPY for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Earnings per share doubled, indicating a significant improvement in per-share profitability.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Measures the company's profitability relative to shareholders' equity.
kpis.description: Return on equity reached 10.0% for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, in line with long-term management targets.
kpis.signal: ROE target achieved, indicating efficient capital management.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per common share.
kpis.description: A total dividend of 57 JPY per share will be paid for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, comprising a regular dividend of 24 JPY and a commemorative dividend of 10 JPY.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in total dividend, including a commemorative dividend.

kpis.name: Wealth Management Income Before Taxes
kpis.explanation: Profit of the Wealth Management division before tax deduction.
kpis.description: The Wealth Management division recorded income before taxes of 170.8 billion JPY for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, the highest in 11 years, supported by a stable growth strategy.
kpis.signal: Wealth Management income before taxes reaches its highest level in 11 years.

kpis.name: Alternative Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Value of alternative assets managed by the company.
kpis.description: Alternative assets under management increased by 40.2% to reach 2,608.2 billion JPY as of March 31, 2025, highlighting the success of the expansion strategy in this area.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in alternative assets under management, indicating increased demand for these asset classes.

kpis.name: Investment Banking Income Before Taxes
kpis.explanation: Profit of the Investment Banking division before tax deduction.
kpis.description: The Investment Banking division saw income before taxes increase by 208.4% to reach 166.3 billion JPY as of March 31, 2025, driven by high client activity and service expansion.
kpis.signal: Spectacular growth in investment banking income before taxes, reaching record levels.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

kpis.name: Investment Management Division Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenus générés par la gestion d'investissements.
kpis.description: The Investment Management division recorded a 24.9% increase in revenues for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, benefiting from an increase in assets under management.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in investment management revenues, reaching record levels.

ai_positioning.summary: Nomura Holdings integrates AI solutions into its financial services to enhance efficiency and customer value. The company emphasizes AI in wealth management and investment services.
evidence: The management strategy aims to increase shareholder value by improving productivity and expanding revenue sources.
The Wealth Management division enhances its services using digital tools and AI solutions to meet client needs.
The Investment Management division is developing internal active investment capabilities and private asset management services.
